main_text.head: DE CIRCUNSTANTIIS PURGATORII, LIBER SECUNDUS.
IN CAPUT I.
I. ART. I.
main_text.p: DEMONSTRAVIMUS hactenus Purgatorium esse: nunc de circumstantiis Purgatorii,] Vulgatum est in Scholis dictum, non entis non esse accidentia. Purgatorium esse negauimus, & confutauimus: ergo & accidentia vel circumstantias eius ullas negamus esse. Unica a nobis est litura totius libri Bellarminei istius.
2. Art.3. Sed videtur esse non eius solum, sed multorū[?]

page.notes: The woodcut headpiece above the title is an ornament and is not transcribed. The woodcut initial D is joined to the first word. The abbreviation on "multorū" is uncertain at the line end. The signature "Ll iiij" is read from a small mark and may be slightly off. Printed u/v were normalised to u for vowels and v for consonants, and the running head has the form "vi." as printed.
